Prizes: 1st prize, 1 winner, $3,000. 2nd prize, 2 winners, $2,000. 3rd prize, 3 winners, $1,000. The winners will be decided by the selection committee and will be announced on December 30th. For more information, visit our website, www.grnftr.org.
